why.sentence: Excluding pools, lockers, and custodians, top-10 holders hold 11.3%, down from 44.03% (H2).
Insider network supply is null, a data artifact over 100%, not real concentration (H3).
$5.96M liquidity and a 0.0287 ratio are typical for this established token, indicating adequate relative liquidity (L1).
A 0.82 buy-sell ratio shows modest sell pressure within typical ranges for mixed activity (L2).
$5.96M liquidity and a -1.81% worst price change show adequate depth with empty danger risks (L3).
metadata_mutable is false, so the update authority cannot alter token metadata (D1).
Creator balance is 0 with null creator, mint, and freeze authorities, leaving no deployer control (D2).

detail.what_would_change_my_mind: A danger-level RugCheck risk, a 50%+ price collapse, verified insider control, drained liquidity, or active mint/freeze authority would change the verdict.
